findings.evidence: Text states "This workspace holds 4 projects" but the list shows only 3 items
findings.violation: The stated project count does not match the displayed count, creating confusion about the workspace state
findings.fix: Either add a fourth project to the list or change the count to 3

findings.violation: The button has no visible text content, only an aria-label, making it unclear to non-assistive-technology users what the button does
findings.fix: Add visible text inside the button (e.g., "Duplicate" or an icon with fallback text) in addition to the aria-label

findings.evidence: An invite was sent to the address entered above. It expires in 5 days if not accepted.
findings.violation: The message refers to "the address entered above" but does not display or confirm which email address the invite was actually sent to
findings.fix: Display the email address that received the invite (e.g., "An invite was sent to john@example.com. It expires in 5 days if not accepted.")

findings.evidence: This workspace holds 4 projects, synced this morning.
findings.violation: The timestamp "this morning" is imprecise and becomes outdated; it does not persist accurately across time zones or viewing times
findings.fix: Replace with a precise timestamp in a standard format (e.g., "Last synced: 2026-07-31 09:30 AM EDT") or a relative time that updates (e.g., "Last synced: 2 hours ago")

findings.violation: The project name is hardcoded in the HTML mockup; if this form is actually used, submitted changes will not be saved because there is no backend or submission handler
findings.fix: Add a form submission handler or clarify in documentation that this is a static mockup

findings.violation: The input has no required attribute, allowing users to attempt to send an invite with no email address entered
findings.fix: Add required attribute to the input field
